findings.title: Docs and severity/trigger rules have no acceptance criterion
findings.detail: The Design promises a capability page "Reviews" listing the three reviewers and their categories. It also promises the rule "a finding without a trigger is at most `minor`" and a `diff` input capped at 1500 lines. None of these appear in the Acceptance criteria or Test plan. Add an AC for the docs page. Add a template/prompt assertion for the severity and trigger rule, or say it is prompt-only guidance and not enforced.

findings.title: Ambiguous whether `trigger` is required and what type `lines` has
findings.detail: The schema shape lists `trigger` and `lines` without saying which finding keys are required, or whether `lines` is an int list, a string list, or a range string. If `trigger` is required, "a finding without a trigger" cannot occur and the 'at most minor' rule is moot. If it is optional, say so, and say whether the schema or the combiner downgrades severity. An unspecified `lines` type makes the schema test and the prompt unpinned.

findings.title: Combiner behaviour for `pass` with `must_fix` is not covered by an AC
findings.detail: The Design says `pass` with a `must_fix` is `fix`. That rule is owned by the SPEC-0201 combiner, but this spec restates it as part of its verdict contract. The e2e AC only covers `must_fix` with `verdict: fix`. Either add a case where the adversarial verdict is `pass` but a finding is `must_fix`, or drop the sentence and refer to SPEC-0201.

findings.title: Manual verification is not checkable
findings.detail: "The next real campaign records this reviewer's verdict and cost here" has no pass criterion. State what to check, for example that a `finding` event with `category` appears in the ledger and that the cost is within the persona's `max_budget_usd`.
